visual_action: A screen recording of a mobile phone shows a photo of Donald Trump being edited. The user navigates a photo editing app, selects the 'filters' menu, chooses the 'Film' category, and applies the 'Satura' filter at 100% intensity. This dramatically changes the color grading of the photo to look more 'cinematic'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A photo of Donald Trump is the subject of the photo editing tutorial shown in the video.

on_screen_text.text: how to make your photos look cinematic!!

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video, only music.
audio_music: A slow, atmospheric pop/R&B track ('SLOW DANCING IN THE DARK' by Joji) plays throughout the video, creating a dramatic and 'cinematic' mood that complements the visual theme of the editing tutorial.
editing_pacing: The video is presented as a screen recording of a tutorial, with static shots of the editing process and simple transitions between screens. The pacing is slow and deliberate, showing each step of applying the filter.
cultural_references: The song 'SLOW DANCING IN THE DARK' by Joji.
The video format itself is a common social media trend of creating 'how-to' or tutorial-style edits.
central_claim: The video uses a tutorial format to mock Donald Trump by applying an overly dramatic 'cinematic' filter to his photo.
intended_effect: To amuse the viewer by juxtaposing a standard photo of Donald Trump with a trendy, dramatic editing style, subtly mocking him.
